title: WritingMedia
description: Writing as a frame (B8 R13-R15): what each carrier (writing_medium vocabulary) is like - how long writing on it lasts, what weather wears it, which tool properties writing on it needs, how readable it can be and how much it holds - and what the actions write and read need. Nothing here says when or whether writing appears: that comes from inventions (B4b) and practice over generations (B9). Values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

write.description: What writing needs: the ability (an ability id of the register, B4b/B5), a carrier and a tool with the carrier's tool properties.

read.description: What reading needs; reading in passing also needs curiosity above the threshold.

decay_per_day.description: Legibility lost per game day by itself (0 = lasts).

weather_loss.description: Extra legibility lost per game hour in a weather (e.g. rain wipes sand).

tool_properties.description: Property ids a tool needs to write on this carrier (empty = a finger is enough).

legibility.description: Best legibility writing on this carrier can have (times the writer's ability).

capacity.description: How many knowledge entries fit on one carrier.

min_level.description: Least ability level (0..1) for the action to work at all.

min_legibility.description: Below this legibility nothing can be read any more (the object stays).

curiosity_trait.description: Trait id that stands for curiosity (reading in passing).
